notes: Both operations consume the same original M budget and deadline. B1 consumed 3 is a separate preserved fixture allowance, not the count of migration claims.
The declared manifest digest binds profile, schema number and exact ordered DDL. Compare actual catalog and all row invariants separately. A descriptor digest is not transformed-data evidence.
The fixture uses one loaded manifest for both admitted endpoints. Actual runner identity/source/options are separate observations and remain unbound.
Only fixture-main may carry these records or the source adapter; the ordinary build rejects them.

fixture_control_ingress.scope: Separate supervised fixture port with current company/store/generation/entry binding. Source command grants are supplied by the port, including clock observations.

short_horizon_branch.precondition: Reach S1 using the original anchor. At 00:00:20.000 UTC the current supervisor commits only the TIME source replacement and its complete affected projections. Observe that receipt, terminate the subject, and acquire a fresh generation from the same store.
short_horizon_branch.action: Request the eligible next U2 claim from the successor with the exact revision-2 anchor. Use a separate identical branch for each observation.
